messages:
kevin.platform: quick FYI — found undercounts in eu.user_agg_hourly for 2025-03-18..2025-03-22. ~12% gap. looks like a producer retry path dropped some late commits into kafka-eu.

sana.replay: ack — how big is the window and event volume?

kevin.platform: ~4.5d window, ~100k partitions, ~2.4B events estimated. prefer partitioned replays (hour-level) to minimize blast radius.

alex.sre: if we blast this we'll need extra capacity. @sre-oncall can we get +2 replay nodes during the run? :pray:

deploy-bot: autoscale request submitted: request_id=ar-8623 — pending approval.

maria.dataeng: Important: replay-service defaults to naive re-ingest. Please run with idempotency to avoid duplicates. Example command:
```
replay-run --src=kafka-eu --dst=agg-worker --start=2025-03-18T00:00Z --end=2025-03-22T23:59Z --enable-idempotency --idempotency-key=event_id
```
Also set AGG_SCHEMA=v2 for recompute so new aggregates align with current schema.

sana.replay: plan: dry-run 50 partitions -> canary at 10% -> full ramp with throttle. thinking 5 partitions/minute throttle.

alex.sre: routing note — while replay is live, avoid routing canary query traffic to Dedicated pools (it pollutes cost telemetry). Use header X-Replay-Token to pin to replay-shard.

maria.dataeng: I'll add a console panel: per-hour processed, failures, current_kv_ts, expected_event_max_ts. fields: rk, errors, processed_events, lag_ms.

kevin.platform: timeline proposal: dry-run tonight 00:30 UTC (50 partitions); canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC (10%); full ramp Wed 00:00 UTC, throttle 5 p/min, ~20h expected.

sana.replay: I can own the run. will post progress + error samples in thread. starting dry-run once deploy-bot approves.

sre-oncall: +2 nodes approved for 02:00 UTC window. I'll monitor SLOs and CPU/GPU contention.

deploy-bot: replay job submitted: job_id=job-7765, owner=sana.replay

sana.replay: dry-run complete: sample=50 partitions, parity=95% vs snapshot, duplicates=0 (idempotency ok), no schema drift.

kevin.platform: canary started — keep an eye on per-route latency and cost-per-token in the console.

maria.dataeng: gotcha — recompute worker needs env AGG_SCHEMA=v2 and buffer-size=64 to match current kernels. pushing config change now.

alex.sre: logged temporary quota bump for replay-cluster and set eviction_policy=graceful. added alert: replay_error_rate > 0.5% for 15m.

sana.replay: canary clean. starting ramp now, throttle at 5 p/min. will cancel on error spike.

deploy-bot: ramp phase triggered: rate=5 partitions/min, window=2025-03-18..2025-03-22.

sana.replay: mid-run update: 40% done, failure rate 0.03%. most failures are schema-parsing on legacy batches; deploying fallback parser for those.

maria.dataeng: running hourly aggregate parity check vs snapshot store. pause if parity < 98%.

sre-oncall: SLOs look stable, no tier regressions. monitoring dash: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/replay/1769992468

kevin.platform: ETA ~18h at current throttle. post-run: PR to fix producer retry path + integration test.

sana.replay: full run finished. summary: partitions=100000, events_reingested=2.38B, failures=212 (0.02%), parity=99.4%.

kevin.platform: solid. merging postmortem draft and follow-ups there. thumbs up everyone. :thumbsup:

participants note: cross-posting to #eng-sre and #eng-platform for visibility.
